title: Add a stock-PPO throughput profiler for Step 2
summary: locomotion.throughput profiles training at one admitted replica count per allocation: one, 32 or 128 robots under the training settings and stock RSL-RL PPO. After warmup it alternates boundary-timed updates, which give transitions per second, with component updates whose exclusive times partition each update. It records allocator, Warp pool, PhysX heap and host memory, runs a contact census after timing, and binds each result to its frozen source, model, inputs and admission. A CPU summarize command compares allocations. Prepare and launch accept the new throughput mode; the replica and update guards, model, limiter and colliders stay unchanged. Native measurements remain pending, and AMP learner costs remain unmeasured.
next: With program-lead approval and matching one-robot and batch admission, profile one, 32 and 128 robots on Spark and publish the summary under #35.
reason: The profiler adds CPU-tested tooling with no native measurement; no roadmap marker, recorded fact or gate changes.
